- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided general information about fishing in Lake Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Species in Lake Michigan include:
  - Salmon (Chinook, coho, pink)
  - Trout (Lake, brown, rainbow)
  - Walleye
  - Bass (Largemouth, smallmouth)
  - Panfish (Yellow perch, bluegill, rock bass)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested fishing spots in Lake Michigan:
  - Harbors and Bays
  - Piers
  - Shoreline
  - Open Water
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tactics and tips for fishing in Lake Michigan:
  - Trolling with spoons, plugs, or flies for salmon and trout
  - Casting with jigs, crankbaits, or spinners for bass, walleye, and panfish
  - Using live bait like nightcrawlers, minnows, or leeches for walleye, bass, and panfish
  - Fishing near structure like reefs, drop-offs, and weed beds
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested checking for licenses, bag limits, and size limits for fishing in Lake Michigan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Best fishing times in Lake Michigan are from spring to fall, with peak seasons varying by species.
